course.name: Computer Science Foundations
course.tagline: The complete foundations course - from bits to the cloud.
course.description: A full 35-part guided course covering everything from what a computer is to cloud computing and AI. Each part explains every term on first use, with worked examples, analogies, tables, diagrams, and self-assessment. Includes a course guide with the complete syllabus (Units A-I).
course.guideTitle: Computer Science Foundations - Course Guide & Syllabus

path.title: Computer Science Foundation
path.tagline: The complete foundations roadmap - guide plus Parts 1-29 in order.
path.description: Follow the course exactly as the book prescribes: orientation, representation, hardware, software, computation, systems and networks, data/security/engineering, and modern computing. Each step is one part of the Computer Science Foundations subject.

units.title: Unit A - Orientation
units.summary: How this course works and the very first concepts: what Computer Science is, what a computer is, and why it matters.

units.title: Unit B - How Computers Represent Information
units.summary: Number systems, bits and bytes, and how numbers, text, images, audio, and video all become binary.

units.title: Unit C - Computer Hardware
units.summary: The physical machine: CPU, memory, storage, motherboard, and the boot process.

units.title: Unit D - Software and Programming
units.summary: Software fundamentals, programming fundamentals, and how code becomes running programs.

units.title: Unit E - Problem Solving and Computation
units.summary: Algorithms, computational thinking, complexity, and data structures.

units.title: Unit F - Systems and Networks
units.summary: Operating systems, files and file systems, computer networking, and the Internet.

units.title: Unit G - Data, Security, and Software Engineering
units.summary: Databases, security, software engineering practices, abstraction and architecture, and APIs.

units.title: Unit H - Modern Computing
units.summary: Cloud computing, virtualization and containers, parallelism and concurrency, and distributed systems - the modern computing landscape.

units.title: Unit I - Artificial Intelligence and Integration
units.summary: AI and machine learning foundations, modern AI engineering (transformers, LLMs, RAG, agents), and how everything connects.
